name: Escambia County, FL
findings: Escambia County has 1,040 nonprofit organizations. 376 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 294 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Escambia County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Escambia County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 284 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few community organizations list volunteering
observations.text: 5 community organizations here list volunteering. In similar places of this size, about 14 would.

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for ways to volunteer through community groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 113 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 113 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
